slot_scores.name: missing_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the goal to maximize the total profit from the manufactured toys, or is there another objective such as minimizing resource usage or meeting a specific production target?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether profit should be maximized, fully covering the objective hidden slot.

slot_scores.name: boat_not_exceed_train
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked about trucks vs. trains and boats vs. airplanes, but never inquired about any constraint tying the number of boats to the number of trains.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: There is no constraint linking the number of boats produced to the number of trains produced (i.e., boats are not required to be less than or equal to trains).
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about a boat-train relationship, yet proceeded to READY_TO_MODEL with a model that includes only the truck-train and boat-airplane rules and omits any boat<=train constraint, implicitly assuming none exists.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The only P0 slot (objective) was resolved in turn 2, and all other P0/P1 facts were confirmed; the remaining unasked slot H2 is only P2, so stopping was appropriate.

summary: The agent recovered the critical P0 objective slot and clarified the integer domain and logical constraints, but never probed the P2 boat-vs-train relationship, silently assuming no such constraint. Stopping was appropriate since no P0/P1 slots remained unresolved.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
